preconditions.description: The lengths of s1 and s2 must be equal.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'xy' for c in s1) and all(c in 'xy' for c in s2)
preconditions.description: Both s1 and s2 must consist only of the characters 'x' and 'y'.
The length of s1 and s2 must be between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == -1 if any(s1[i] != s2[i] for i in range(len(s1))) and (s1.count('x') + s2.count('x')) % 2 != 0 else True
postconditions.description: If the strings cannot be made equal due to an odd count of 'x' or 'y', return -1.
The output must be the minimum number of swaps required to make s1 and s2 equal.
